q: The wise speak only of what they know.
You purchase pain with all that joy can give and die of nothing but a rage to live.
Nothing is more creative...nor destructive...than a brilliant mind with a purpose.
If you get up one more time than you fall, you will make it through.
The greater the impact you want to make, the greater your influence needs to be.
The right thing to do and the hard thing to do are usually the same.
To live is to be willing to die over and over again.
Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose.
Tradition is the illusion of permanence.
To know even one life has breathed easier because you have lived. This is to have succeeded.
Be careful the environment you choose for it will shape you; be careful the friends you choose for you will become like them.
There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
Where there's life, there's hope.
True love stories never have endings.
You've got to get up every morning with determination if you're going to go to bed with satisfaction.
Friends ask you questions; enemies question you.
A pessimist is one who makes difficulties of his opportunities and an optimist is one who makes opportunities of his difficulties.
Walk slowly but never walk backward.
A real decision is measured by the fact that you've taken a new action. If there's no action, you haven't truly decided.
We are all different. Don't judge, understand instead.
Eighty percent of success is showing up.
Some people are old at 18 and some are young at 90. Time is a concept that humans created.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you've imagined.
Human happiness and moral duty are inseparably connected.
Don't set your own goals by what other people make important.
There is always room in your life for thinking bigger, pushing limits and imagining the impossible.
Wherever you are, and whatever you do, be in love.
A comfort zone is a beautiful place, but nothing ever grows there.
To know your Enemy, you must become your Enemy.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
Your very silence shows you agree.
A person without a sense of humor is like a wagon without springs, jolted by every pebble in the road.
Keep away from people who try to belittle your ambitions.
Do not fight with pigs - you will be smeared in mud but the pig will like it.
A man who cannot tolerate small misfortunes can never accomplish great things.
Men trust their ears less than their eyes.
Creativity is the greatest rebellion in existence.
Thinking is a habit, and like any other habit, it can be changed; it just takes effort and repetition.
Life is ten percent what you experience and ninety percent how you respond to it.
If you want peace, accept. If you want suffering, expect.
The only way it gets better for you is when you get better. Better is not something you wish, it's something you become.
It matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be.
What you resist, persists.
Confidence is the greatest friend.
You can never get enough of what you don't need to make you happy.
Death and life have their determined appointments; riches and honors depend upon heaven.
A day without laughter is a day wasted.
I love fools' experiments. I am always making them.
Be like a postage stamp. Stick to it until you get there.
Your hardest times often lead to the greatest moments of your life. Keep going. Tough situations build strong people in the end.
